properties.titulo_evento: Mass Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow kills two, Russia says
properties.descricao: Moscow mayor reports intercepting 1,600 drones during 'unprecedented' attack, accusing Ukraine of election interference.

properties.titulo_evento: Iran war live: Tehran sets terms for talks; Saudi forces foil Riyadh attack
properties.descricao: Iran security chief says Tehran's demands include an end to war on all fronts and the lifting of the US naval blockade.

properties.titulo_evento: Turkiye backs Saudi Arabia’s security amid escalating Houthi attacks: FM
properties.descricao: Turkish FM highlights Turkiye's readiness to assist Saudi Arabia militarily, as Houthi attacks intensify in Yemen.

properties.titulo_evento: Saudi-led coalition says defence intercepted Houthi missile fired at Riyadh
properties.descricao: It was the first air raid alert in Riyadh since an escalation in fighting between the Houthis in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.

properties.titulo_evento: Israel’s president pardons soldier who killed wounded Palestinian in 2016
properties.descricao: Elor Azaria had shot a Palestinian who had already been incapacitated by Israeli troops, in controversial case.

properties.titulo_evento: Two killed in 'massive' Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, Russia says
properties.descricao: An oil refinery was also hit in the Russian capital and flights were suspended at two airports.

properties.titulo_evento: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
properties.descricao: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

properties.titulo_evento: Millions without power as Cuba hit by latest major blackout
properties.descricao: Widespread power outages have become increasingly common due to fuel shortages made worse by a US blockade.

properties.titulo_evento: Russia: Ukrainian drone strike on Moscow kills 2
properties.descricao: An oil refinery was hit in one of the largest attacks so far on the Russian capital, as the country holds a parliamentary election. Meanwhile, at least four people were killed in Russian strikes in Ukraine's Kyiv region.

properties.titulo_evento: Ed Sheeran speaks on Gaza in concert after Macklemore controversy
properties.descricao: Sheeran called the Hamas-led attack in Israel "horrific" and described the war in Gaza as "catastrophic and unjustifiable" during his first concert since the Macklemore controversy erupted.

properties.titulo_evento: In cosmopolitan Berlin, elections still closed to foreigners
properties.descricao: A quarter of Berlin residents will have no say in the German capital's city-state election because they lack citizenship. That's the highest proportion of residents excluded from the election yet, and many are unhappy.

properties.titulo_evento: Germany: Polls open in two key state elections
properties.descricao: Voting in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania is expected to bring gains for the far-right AfD party and could determine whether Chancellor Friedrich Merz can hold on to power. Follow DW live.

properties.titulo_evento: Ukraine steps up measures to protect railways
properties.descricao: As Russia increases its attacks on Ukraine's rail infrastructure, the Ukrainian government has called for help to replace destroyed locomotives and is making plans to keep passengers safe.

properties.titulo_evento: Saudi Arabia: Houthis claim strikes on Riyadh, Yanbu port
properties.descricao: The Yemen-based Houthis said they targeted "sensitive sites" in Riyadh, hours after a blaze at a fuel depot near the Saudi capital's main airport. The Saudi-led coalition said Saudi defense downed a ballistic missile.

properties.titulo_evento: Airport malaria in Germany remains infrequent
properties.descricao: An outbreak of malaria at Frankfurt Airport this summer has raised alarm. Experts believe parasites probably arrived in a passenger's luggage. But with the onset of fall, the risks of contracting the disease are low.

properties.titulo_evento: Fact Check: False video alleges Berlin votes destroyed
properties.descricao: A video claiming to show AfD postal ballots being destroyed has gone viral ahead of Berlin's September 20 election. DW Fact Check examines the footage, the accounts sharing it and how widely it is really being viewed.

properties.titulo_evento: France’s National Rally criticizes Russia in rare rebuke
properties.descricao: The far-right party has been divided over its stance toward Russia.

properties.titulo_evento: Germany’s top general to lead NATO’s highest military authority
properties.descricao: Carsten Breuer — widely seen as the front-runner — beat out Canada's Jennie Carignan for the role of NATO military committee chair.

properties.titulo_evento: Germany cuts fuel tax as Middle East conflicts send prices soaring
properties.descricao: Germany issues its relief measures as its finance minister calls on Brussels to draft a windfall tax proposal on oil companies.

properties.titulo_evento: Inside the secret race to become NATO’s next top general
properties.descricao: Germany's Carsten Breuer and Canada's Jennie Carignan are battling it out to become to next chair of NATO's military committee.

properties.titulo_evento: India Is Again Squeezed Between the Threat of Trump Tariffs and Russian Oil
properties.descricao: India is trying to secure affordable energy while preserving a crucial relationship with Washington, a balancing act made harder by turmoil in global energy markets.

properties.titulo_evento: What Set Off the Rise in Interest Rates? Mainly, the Iran War.
properties.descricao: The Federal Reserve is trying to catch up with the leap in bond rates as the Middle East conflict unnerves world markets.

properties.titulo_evento: Kremlin Moves to Seize Control of Nestlé’s Russia Operations
properties.descricao: The Swiss maker of KitKats and Nescafé said it was assessing the situation after the Kremlin issued a presidential decree.
